questions.question: Can two discount codes be applied to one order, and if so do they stack?
questions.assumed: One code per order; applying a second replaces the first.

questions.question: Is the discount taken off before tax or after it?
questions.assumed: Before tax: the discount reduces the item total, and tax is worked out on the reduced amount.

questions.question: What happens when a code expires between Apply and Finish?
questions.assumed: The code is checked again at Finish; an expired code is removed and the shopper is told before the order is placed.

questions.question: Can a code bring the total below zero, or below the tax amount?
questions.assumed: The discount is capped at the item total, so the total is never below the tax on zero.

questions.question: Is the code case-sensitive, and are spaces around it ignored?
questions.assumed: Codes are matched ignoring case and surrounding spaces.

questions.question: What does the shopper see if they press Apply with the field empty?
questions.assumed: A message says a code is needed and nothing else changes.

questions.question: If the shopper goes back to the cart and then returns to checkout, is the code still applied?
questions.assumed: Yes: the applied code is kept with the cart until the order is placed or the cart is emptied.

questions.question: Does an applied code survive a reload of the overview page?
questions.assumed: Yes, the discount line and the lowered total are still shown after a reload.

questions.question: What happens when the same valid code is applied twice?
questions.assumed: The second Apply does nothing new: one discount line, the same total, no error.

questions.question: Can the same shopper use a single-use code on a second order?
questions.assumed: No: a single-use code is rejected on the second order with the invalid-code message.

questions.question: After an order with a code, does a new cart start without a code applied?
questions.assumed: Yes: the code is cleared with the cart once the order is placed.
